preregistration.name: Proxima Milestone 10 frozen-detector five-band small survey
preregistration.scientific_target: A narrowband transmitter stable in the planet frame and not necessarily aimed at Earth
preregistration.selection_rule: Use six previously unextracted 2 Hz P1018_2 filterbanks: the second complete 30-minute Proxima ON scan on 2021-04-30 and its following 1421-490_S control, followed by the earliest complete ON/control pairs on the two previously unused campaign dates 2021-05-02 and 2021-05-03. Search five predeclared 1 MHz planet-frame intervals distributed across the 1400-1427 MHz passive band, with no overlap with any Milestone 6-9 search interval and no overlap with the immediate H I line region.
preregistration.survey_scope: Independent in searched frequency and source filterbank payload from Milestone 9. Two dates are new to the project; the 2021-04-30 date was used previously but this later ON/OFF pair is a different, non-overlapping observation. All scans belong to the same April-May 2021 campaign.
preregistration.method_note: The Milestone 8-9 v0.4.0 recurrence statistic, S/N floor, moving per-epoch RFI mask, spectral widths, candidate clustering, family flags, orbital bank, and completeness procedure are copied without adjustment. Only scan selection, five fresh bands, and random seeds differ.
preregistration.archive_availability_note: The published campaign also describes November 2020 and January 2021 observations, but those filterbanks were not returned by either the general public archive query or the paper-specific Sheikh21b public API on the preregistration date. Milestone 10 therefore uses unused public April-May 2021 files and does not claim an independent observing campaign.
preregistration.prior_data_contact: Archive catalogue records and SIGPROC headers were inspected to verify public availability, identity, completeness, cadence, resolution, and coverage. No spectral payload from these six files or five search bands was extracted or inspected before preregistration.
preregistration.control_cadence_limit: Each 30-minute ON scan is paired with the immediately following 5-minute 1421-490_S scan. OFF controls therefore have one-sixth the integration time and are less sensitive than the ON scans.
preregistration.data_release: Breakthrough Listen Parkes P1018_2 blc05 public filterbanks; Sheikh21b release

completeness.method: Real m10_1412p5 planet-frame noise vectors are independently circularly shifted by epoch; signals use time-averaged sinc-squared leakage and model acceleration within each integration.
completeness.ideal_snr_definition: Single-epoch S/N the same total signal power would produce as a stationary bin-centred one-channel tone.

interpretation_limits: This search covers 5 disjoint planet-frame bands totaling 5 MHz, not the full receiver band.
A null result constrains only signals present in at least two of the three epochs and represented by the orbital template bank.
The 1/3/5/9-channel boxcars approximate, but do not exactly match, every fractional-bin and acceleration-smeared line shape.
Completeness is measured for exact orbital-bank templates active in epochs 1 and 3; it is not yet marginalized over orbital-model error or every duty cycle.
When configured, the recurrence guard requires every claimed active epoch to exceed its stated single-epoch S/N floor.
The strong-single-epoch RFI mask and recurrence statistic were added after the first Milestone 7 diagnostic run; independent future bands are required for confirmation.
The per-epoch RFI mask follows each circularly shifted epoch in the empirical null and completeness trials.
Scramble p-values are empirical ranks with resolution 1/(N+1), not Gaussian sigma conversions.
